lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits, with the most distinct column containing 4-5 spots in a near-linear vertical arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a nascent grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical transition from high luminance on the dorsal surface to lower luminance on the lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An elongated, dark, low-luminance feature is present on the mid-lateral flank, indicative of an attached external organism.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a dense distribution of small, moderately-luminescent blobs that are significantly smaller than the primary flank constellations.
